args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on your Hawaii vacation itinerary (June 10-20, 2024), here's your complete packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (high SPF for tropical sun protection)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike and other outdoor activities)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and relaxation)
- Camera (to capture memories of your Hawaiian adventure)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, hotel confirmations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (if you prefer your own)
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Light rain jacket (for tropical showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Evening wear (for the Luau experience)

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger for electronics
- Reusable water bottle
